CS80 0.2.0 for Windows (64-bit VST3, Windows 10 or 11)

Copy the CS80.vst3 folder to C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
then rescan plug-ins in your DAW (Ableton Live, Cubase, FL Studio, Reaper,
Bitwig, Studio One). It is listed as leblancfg > CS80.

The faceplate uses Microsoft Edge WebView2, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.

The download isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen or your browser may
warn about it. If Windows blocks the files, right-click the zip, choose
Properties, tick Unblock, and extract it again.

Source and notes: https://github.com/leblancfg/cs80
